experiments._typedRoutesComment: typedRoutes is intentionally off. It requires a generated .expo/types/router.d.ts, which only expo start/export produces, so enabling it would make `tsc --noEmit` fail on a clean checkout and in CI.

extra._comment: Client-visible configuration only. Never place a service-role key, an extraction API key or a database URL in this file: an app bundle is trivially extractable.
